label: Queijo do Pico
aka: Queijo de São João do Pico

about.text: Originating from the island of Pico, this cured cheese is produced in cylindrical formats from cow milk It is considered a fatty cheese and the ripening of the cheese forms a yellow exterior irregular crust and yellowish-white, soft and pasty interior. Pico cheese has a salty taste and a, characteristically, intense aroma.

facts.v: Raw cow's milk set with animal rennet at 26–27 °C for 45–60 minutes; the curd is cut, drained, moulded and pressed by hand
Cured at least 20 days, up to 28, at 10–15 °C and 80–85 % relative humidity
